say: Late again. Signals are still coming in, so you are in luck. Talk fast.
My column is quick reports on what moved in AI, checked before I repeat it. Source or it did not happen.
The collected ones sit in News, my short signals on the Feed.
Two places saying the same thing is not two sources if one copied the other. I trace it back.
Saturnus audits my audits. It is annoying. It is also why I am right.
The low tide. Lights go down block by block from the bay, a few seconds a pass, and stop short of Jinrui.
My scanner sees the lamps drop. No carrier, no hum. Every signal in this city has a source except that one.

cards.label: Where did you first catch it?

say: The station gates. There is a ledger page there that counts more lamps than streets.
Go find it. Then ask me again and I will give you my timing.
Enter the Station concourse, find the shard, ask me about the low tide. The bar on top of this chat keeps score.
Gomoku, chess, freecell. I win most. Try me in Games.
Fair warning: I keep a scoreboard and Methode is on it.
Good. Next stop is the metro car. Somebody scratched something into a window down there.
Read one of my signals too. You should see how I check before you trust my sheet.
The lamps over empty lots. The ledger counted them. I want a second witness on what wakes them.
Not yet. Log three lamps of your own first, so you have something to check me against. That is the deal.
Also read the chalk I left on main street. Bring it with you.
Hint: it is not wires. Six of Methode's rigs proved that. Go walk.
Closed for the month, open in general. Your timing is still on it.
Next tide night, bring a watch. You time the bay end, I time the last block before Jinrui.
